You don’t have to go viral or post every day to make real money from your handmade business.

I turned my polymer clay hobby into a $176,000/year business working just a few hours a week without chasing followers or making more than 30 reels a month.

That’s exactly why I made this video, to show you the real ways I made it happen (and how you can too).

Here’s what you’ll learn in this video:
 ✔️ The one decision that 15x’ed my sales overnight
 ✔️ How to choose a niche that actually brings in sales
 ✔️ How you can strategically increase your pricing and sales
 ✔️ The marketing approach that got me huge orders
 ✔️ And how to build your own professional online shop in less than 30 minutes (no tech skill required)
